title: NGC 2467 and surroundings
caption: The stellar nursery around NGC 2467, imaged by the MPG/ESO 2.2-meter telescope at La Silla
celestial: NGC 2467 · constellation Puppis · about 13000 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESO press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: Pink regions of glowing gas, spread across the frame like a colorful ghost or a giant mandrill's face, surround several clusters of stars. This is the area around the star cluster NGC 2467, in the southern constellation of Puppis (the Stern).

No more than a few million years old, this is a busy stellar nursery in which stars are still being born from large clouds of dust and gas. The pink areas are vast regions of ionized gas, lit up by the energetic light of young stars.

The open cluster Haffner 18 sits at the center, and Haffner 19 lies at middle right inside a smaller pink region, the mandrill's lower eye. At the center of the largest pink region, at the bottom, shines HD 64315, a massive young star that plays a part in shaping the structure of the whole nebula. The image was taken through a wide range of filters, from ultraviolet through visible light, including ones for oxygen and hydrogen.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (29.77 x 29.77 arcminutes) and distance (13000 light years), the frame spans roughly 113 × 113 light-years. Its light set out about 13,000 years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: This image from the Wide Field Imager combines ultraviolet, B, V and R filters with narrow filters for oxygen and hydrogen light. The source does not publish which color was assigned to each filter.
understand.eye: Part of the data is ultraviolet, invisible to the eye, and long exposures bring out faint gas that would be invisible by eye.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

alt: Pink regions of glowing gas around several star clusters, resembling a ghost or a mandrill's face, with a bright star at the center of the largest pink region at the bottom.
